definition: the part of a cooker that produces a flame or heat
sentence: Turn the back {burner} down before the soup boils over.
translation: Убавь заднюю конфорку, пока суп не убежал.

definition: a dead body kept from decaying by ancient Egyptian methods, or mother in child's speech
sentence: The museum's {mummy} is more than three thousand years old.
translation: Мумии в музее больше трёх тысяч лет.

definition: a short knife with a sharp point used as a weapon
sentence: The guard found a {dagger} hidden in the visitor's boot.
translation: Охранник нашёл кинжал, спрятанный в сапоге посетителя.

definition: ancient times, or an object from that period
sentence: The temple dates from {antiquity} and is still standing.
translation: Храм построен в древности и до сих пор стоит.

definition: a mix of flour, fat and water for making pies, or a small sweet cake
sentence: Roll the {pastry} thin and lay it over the apples.
translation: Раскатай тесто тонко и накрой им яблоки.

definition: an injury to the brain caused by a blow to the head
sentence: The rider suffered a {concussion} when she fell from the horse.
translation: Наездница получила сотрясение мозга, упав с лошади.

definition: a wooden or metal cover for a window
sentence: Close the {shutter} to keep the afternoon sun out.
translation: Закрой ставни, чтобы не впускать послеполуденное солнце.

definition: a small difference in meaning, sound or feeling
sentence: A good translator catches every {nuance} of the original.
translation: Хороший переводчик улавливает каждый нюанс оригинала.

definition: a movement that the body makes automatically in response to something
sentence: A doctor tests the knee {reflex} with a small hammer.
translation: Врач проверяет коленный рефлекс маленьким молоточком.

definition: a person who commits a crime or does something harmful
sentence: Police still have not found the {perpetrator} of the attack.
translation: Полиция до сих пор не нашла виновника нападения.

definition: to consider one thing to be the same as another
sentence: You should not {equate} being quiet with being shy.
translation: Не стоит отождествлять молчаливость с застенчивостью.

definition: the right to have or do something, or the belief that you deserve special treatment
sentence: Every worker has an {entitlement} to four weeks of paid holiday.
translation: Каждый работник имеет право на четыре недели оплачиваемого отпуска.

definition: a box or structure where bees live, or a very busy place
sentence: The farmer keeps a {hive} at the end of the orchard.
translation: Фермер держит улей в конце сада.

definition: a person, animal or vehicle that competes to be fastest
sentence: The young {racer} finished second in her first big competition.
translation: Юная гонщица финишировала второй на своих первых крупных соревнованиях.

definition: a large picture painted directly on a wall
sentence: A {mural} of the harbour covers the whole side of the library.
translation: Настенная роспись с видом гавани покрывает всю боковую стену библиотеки.

definition: a factory where oil, sugar or metal is made pure
sentence: The {refinery} turns crude oil into petrol and diesel.
translation: Завод перерабатывает сырую нефть в бензин и дизель.

definition: the study of human societies, customs and beliefs
sentence: She studied {anthropology} and lived with a tribe in Borneo for a year.
translation: Она изучала антропологию и год жила с племенем на Борнео.

definition: a tall plant with hard empty stems, used for building and furniture
sentence: The fence is made of {bamboo} tied together with rope.
translation: Забор сделан из бамбука, связанного верёвкой.

definition: a herb with a sweet smell used in Italian cooking
sentence: Tear a few leaves of {basil} over the tomatoes.
translation: Порви несколько листьев базилика над помидорами.

definition: a soldier of low rank, just above a private
sentence: The {corporal} led the small patrol along the river.
translation: Капрал вёл небольшой патруль вдоль реки.

definition: an open area surrounded by walls or buildings
sentence: The hotel rooms look onto a quiet {courtyard} with a fountain.
translation: Номера отеля выходят в тихий внутренний двор с фонтаном.

definition: the act of making someone believe something that is not true
sentence: The whole sale was a {deception}; the car had been stolen.
translation: Вся сделка была обманом: машина была украдена.

definition: the style of furniture and colours in a room or building
sentence: The restaurant's {decor} is simple: white walls and wooden tables.
translation: Интерьер ресторана прост: белые стены и деревянные столы.

definition: a feeling of slight pain or of being physically uncomfortable
sentence: You may feel some {discomfort} for a day after the injection.
translation: В течение дня после укола вы можете чувствовать лёгкий дискомфорт.

definition: in a way that is extreme and sudden
sentence: Prices fell {drastically} when the new shop opened.
translation: Цены резко упали, когда открылся новый магазин.

definition: a short private road leading from the street to a house
sentence: He parked the car in the {driveway} and went inside.
translation: Он поставил машину на подъездной дорожке и вошёл в дом.

definition: in equal amounts, or smoothly without changes
sentence: Spread the butter {evenly} over the bread.
translation: Намажь масло на хлеб ровным слоем.

definition: popular at a particular time, or following the latest style
sentence: Short hair is {fashionable} again this year.
translation: В этом году короткие волосы снова в моде.

definition: causing fear or respect because of being very large, strong or difficult
sentence: Climbing the north face is a {formidable} challenge even for experts.
translation: Подъём по северной стене — серьёзное испытание даже для профессионалов.

definition: not clear in shape or sound, or covered with soft hair
sentence: The photo is too {fuzzy} to read the number plate.
translation: Фото слишком размытое, чтобы прочитать номер машины.

definition: in the style of the Middle Ages with pointed arches, or dark and mysterious
sentence: The cathedral is a fine example of {gothic} architecture.
translation: Собор — прекрасный образец готической архитектуры.

definition: very much or to a very great degree
sentence: The festival has been {hugely} popular with families.
translation: Фестиваль пользовался огромной популярностью у семей.

definition: pretending to have beliefs or standards that you do not really have
sentence: It is {hypocrisy} to preach saving while flying every weekend.
translation: Лицемерие — проповедовать экономию, летая каждые выходные.

definition: not correct or exact
sentence: The map was {inaccurate} and led us into a swamp.
translation: Карта была неточной и завела нас в болото.

definition: the beginning of an organisation or activity
sentence: Since its {inception} in 1990 the charity has built forty schools.
translation: С момента основания в 1990 году организация построила сорок школ.

definition: not having the skill or ability to do something properly
sentence: The {incompetent} plumber left the kitchen flooded.
translation: Неумелый сантехник оставил кухню затопленной.

definition: for a period of time with no fixed end
sentence: The match has been postponed {indefinitely} because of the flooding.
translation: Матч отложен на неопределённый срок из-за наводнения.

definition: your family and relatives
sentence: The police inform the next of {kin} before they tell the press.
translation: Полиция сообщает ближайшим родственникам, прежде чем сообщать прессе.

definition: the sadness of being alone or without friends
sentence: Many old people suffer from {loneliness} after their partner dies.
translation: Многие пожилые люди страдают от одиночества после смерти супруга.

definition: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes in hot countries
sentence: Take the tablets every day to protect yourself from {malaria}.
translation: Принимайте таблетки каждый день, чтобы защититься от малярии.

definition: a written statement of a party's or group's aims and plans
sentence: The party's {manifesto} promises free school meals for every child.
translation: Манифест партии обещает бесплатные школьные обеды каждому ребёнку.

definition: a network of paths designed so that it is hard to find the way out
sentence: We got lost in the {maze} of narrow streets behind the market.
translation: Мы заблудились в лабиринте узких улочек за рынком.

definition: by a very small amount
sentence: The cyclist {narrowly} missed the dog that ran into the road.
translation: Велосипедист едва не сбил собаку, выбежавшую на дорогу.

definition: failure to take enough care, especially when it causes harm
sentence: The company was found guilty of {negligence} after the fire.
translation: После пожара компанию признали виновной в халатности.

definition: expressed in numbers or relating to numbers
sentence: Put the files in {numerical} order before you file them.
translation: Расположи файлы в числовом порядке, прежде чем подшивать.

definition: no longer used because something newer has replaced it
sentence: Film cameras became {obsolete} within a decade.
translation: Плёночные фотоаппараты устарели за десятилетие.

definition: relating to the eyes or to seeing
sentence: The {optic} nerve carries signals from the eye to the brain.
translation: Зрительный нерв передаёт сигналы от глаза к мозгу.

definition: the period of training and friendly matches before a sports season begins
sentence: The club plays five friendly games in {preseason}.
translation: Клуб проводит пять товарищеских матчей в предсезонке.

definition: a deep full sound, or a quality that makes something meaningful to people
sentence: The old story still has {resonance} for young readers today.
translation: Старая история до сих пор находит отклик у молодых читателей.

definition: having no pity, doing anything to get what you want
sentence: Their boss is {ruthless} about deadlines.
translation: Их начальник беспощаден, когда дело касается сроков.

definition: a member of the military class in Japan in the past
sentence: The {samurai} carried two swords as a sign of his rank.
translation: Самурай носил два меча как знак своего положения.

definition: a way of criticising people or ideas by making them seem funny
sentence: The play is a {satire} on politicians who promise everything.
translation: Пьеса — сатира на политиков, которые обещают всё подряд.

definition: fish and other sea creatures eaten as food
sentence: The restaurant by the harbour serves the freshest {seafood} in town.
translation: Ресторан у гавани подаёт самые свежие морепродукты в городе.

definition: long thin pieces of Italian food made from flour and water
sentence: Boil the {spaghetti} for eight minutes and drain it.
translation: Вари спагетти восемь минут и слей воду.

definition: quick, or done without delay
sentence: We wish you a {speedy} recovery after the operation.
translation: Желаем вам скорейшего выздоровления после операции.

definition: a particular way of thinking about a subject
sentence: From a purely financial {standpoint}, the plan makes no sense.
translation: С чисто финансовой точки зрения план не имеет смысла.

definition: the force that makes something turn around a point
sentence: The engine produces enough {torque} to pull a boat up the slope.
translation: Двигатель даёт достаточно крутящего момента, чтобы втащить лодку на склон.

definition: not allowed by the basic laws of a country
sentence: The court ruled the new ban {unconstitutional}.
translation: Суд признал новый запрет неконституционным.

definition: relating to the skills needed for a particular job
sentence: The college offers {vocational} courses in cooking and car repair.
translation: Колледж предлагает профессиональные курсы по кулинарии и ремонту автомобилей.

definition: a blue-white metal used to protect iron from rust and in medicines
sentence: The roof is covered with sheets of {zinc} that never rust.
translation: Крыша покрыта листами цинка, которые никогда не ржавеют.

definition: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid
sentence: {Dilute} the juice with water before you give it to the baby.
translation: Разбавь сок водой, прежде чем давать малышу.

definition: a journalist who writes a regular article giving opinions
sentence: The {columnist} attacks the government every Sunday.
translation: Колумнист критикует правительство каждое воскресенье.

definition: a light frame covered with paper that flies in the wind on a long string
sentence: The children flew a red {kite} on the windy beach.
translation: Дети запускали красного воздушного змея на ветреном пляже.

definition: an extremely cruel and violent act, especially in a war
sentence: The court heard evidence of every {atrocity} committed in the village.
translation: Суд заслушал показания о каждом зверстве, совершённом в деревне.

definition: to go down so that the middle joints of your legs rest on the ground
sentence: You have to {kneel} to see under the car.
translation: Нужно встать на колени, чтобы заглянуть под машину.

definition: a long coat without sleeves that hangs from the neck
sentence: The rider pulled his {cloak} tight against the wind.
translation: Всадник плотнее запахнул плащ от ветра.

definition: to live in a place, used in formal or literary language
sentence: Few people still {dwell} in the high valleys in winter.
translation: Мало кто ещё живёт в высокогорных долинах зимой.

definition: sand, mud or small pieces that settle at the bottom of a liquid
sentence: A layer of {sediment} covers the bottom of the lake.
translation: Слой осадка покрывает дно озера.

definition: a meeting of members of a political party to choose candidates or decide policy
sentence: The party's {caucus} picked a surprise candidate for mayor.
translation: Партийное собрание выбрало неожиданного кандидата в мэры.

definition: a seat with legs but no back or arms
sentence: He sat on a high {stool} at the bar and ordered a coffee.
translation: Он сел на высокий табурет у стойки и заказал кофе.

definition: the process of becoming smaller or tighter, or a muscle tightening before birth
sentence: Cold causes the {contraction} of metal, so the bridge shrinks in winter.
translation: Холод вызывает сжатие металла, поэтому зимой мост становится короче.

definition: a unit for measuring liquid, equal to 1,000 millilitres
sentence: Add a {liter} of water for every cup of rice.
translation: Добавь литр воды на каждую чашку риса.

definition: a game or race that decides who takes part in a competition
sentence: The team needs a win in the last {qualifier} to reach the World Cup.
translation: Команде нужна победа в последнем отборочном матче, чтобы попасть на чемпионат мира.

definition: a device that joins two pieces of equipment or two wires
sentence: The cable has a {connector} that fits any laptop.
translation: У кабеля разъём, подходящий к любому ноутбуку.

definition: one of the tiny holes in the skin through which sweat comes
sentence: Steam opens every {pore} in the skin and cleans it.
translation: Пар открывает каждую пору кожи и очищает её.

definition: to go back to a previous state or way of behaving
sentence: After the holiday he will {revert} to his old habits.
translation: После отпуска он вернётся к старым привычкам.

definition: a soft shoe with a rubber bottom, worn for sport or every day
sentence: He bought a new pair of white {sneakers} for the summer.
translation: Он купил новую пару белых кроссовок на лето.

definition: to lead someone to a place, or to be the start of something new
sentence: The guard will {usher} the visitors into the hall.
translation: Охранник проведёт посетителей в зал.

definition: a large reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth that lives in rivers
sentence: A {crocodile} lay still on the muddy bank, waiting.
translation: Крокодил неподвижно лежал на илистом берегу и ждал.

definition: an expression of sympathy to someone whose relative or friend has died
sentence: She sent a letter of {condolence} to the widow.
translation: Она отправила вдове письмо с соболезнованиями.

definition: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh
sentence: He cut the {pineapple} into rings for the cake.
translation: Он нарезал ананас кольцами для торта.

definition: a set of stairs inside a building, with its rails and supports
sentence: A wooden {staircase} leads up to the two bedrooms.
translation: Деревянная лестница ведёт наверх к двум спальням.

definition: a pair of small speakers worn over the ears with a small microphone
sentence: The pilot spoke to the tower through his {headset}.
translation: Пилот говорил с диспетчером через гарнитуру.

definition: a detailed plan for a building or machine, or for how to achieve something
sentence: The report is a {blueprint} for cleaner cities by 2040.
translation: Отчёт — план действий по созданию более чистых городов к 2040 году.

definition: to be impossible for someone to understand or explain
sentence: The disappearance of the ship continues to {baffle} experts.
translation: Исчезновение корабля продолжает ставить экспертов в тупик.

definition: a sweet juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom
sentence: She sliced a ripe {pear} into the salad.
translation: Она нарезала спелую грушу в салат.

definition: to run slowly and steadily for exercise
sentence: I {jog} around the park every morning before work.
translation: Каждое утро перед работой я бегаю трусцой вокруг парка.

definition: to treat people cruelly and unfairly, especially by not giving them rights
sentence: The regime continued to {oppress} anyone who spoke against it.
translation: Режим продолжал притеснять всех, кто выступал против него.

definition: a long strap used to control a horse, or control over something
sentence: She pulled on the {rein} and the horse stopped.
translation: Она натянула повод, и лошадь остановилась.

definition: great sadness or trouble, used in old or literary language
sentence: The letter was full of {woe} about the lost harvest.
translation: Письмо было полно горя из-за погибшего урожая.

definition: a substance that gives colour to paint, skin or plants
sentence: The red {pigment} in the cave paintings came from iron.
translation: Красный пигмент в наскальных рисунках получали из железа.

definition: a person who travels regularly between home and work
sentence: Every {commuter} on the platform looked at their phone.
translation: Каждый пассажир на платформе смотрел в телефон.

definition: a small cheap restaurant, especially in the USA, or a person eating in a restaurant
sentence: We stopped at a roadside {diner} for eggs and coffee.
translation: Мы остановились в придорожной закусочной поесть яичницы с кофе.

definition: the distance between two waves of sound or light, or a shared way of thinking
sentence: Red light has a longer {wavelength} than blue.
translation: У красного света длина волны больше, чем у синего.

definition: to copy the way someone speaks, moves or does something
sentence: Children {imitate} what their parents do, not what they say.
translation: Дети подражают тому, что делают родители, а не тому, что они говорят.

definition: the least valuable piece in chess, or a person used by others
sentence: He moved a {pawn} forward and waited for her reply.
translation: Он передвинул пешку вперёд и стал ждать её ответа.

definition: to make yourself or someone else used to something
sentence: It took a week to {accustom} the puppy to sleeping alone.
translation: Понадобилась неделя, чтобы приучить щенка спать одному.

definition: well enough for a purpose
sentence: The old heater cannot warm the hall {adequately} in winter.
translation: Старый обогреватель не может достаточно прогреть зал зимой.

definition: in a very surprising way
sentence: {Amazingly}, nobody was hurt when the roof fell in.
translation: Удивительно, но никто не пострадал, когда обрушилась крыша.

definition: to be close to something in amount or nature but not exact
sentence: The model can only {approximate} what the real storm will do.
translation: Модель может лишь приблизительно показать, что сделает настоящий шторм.

definition: discussion between people trying to agree a price or deal
sentence: After an hour of {bargaining}, we bought the carpet for half the price.
translation: После часа торга мы купили ковёр за полцены.

definition: a short stick passed between runners in a relay, or used by a conductor
sentence: The runner dropped the {baton} and the team lost the race.
translation: Бегун уронил эстафетную палочку, и команда проиграла забег.

definition: the end of a marriage or relationship, or the division of a large thing
sentence: After the {breakup} she moved back to her parents' house.
translation: После разрыва она вернулась в дом родителей.

definition: the place in a shop where you pay, or the time you leave a hotel
sentence: There was a long queue at the {checkout} on Saturday.
translation: В субботу у кассы была длинная очередь.

definition: a brown powder made from beans, used for chocolate, or a hot drink of it
sentence: She made a cup of hot {cocoa} with milk and sugar.
translation: Она приготовила чашку горячего какао с молоком и сахаром.

definition: a large collection of texts used for studying a language
sentence: The dictionary is based on a {corpus} of a billion words.
translation: Словарь основан на корпусе из миллиарда слов.

definition: a small bay with a curved shore, often protected by high rocks
sentence: The boat anchored in a quiet {cove} for the night.
translation: Лодка на ночь встала на якорь в тихой бухте.

definition: warm, comfortable and pleasant
sentence: The cabin was {cozy} with a fire burning in the corner.
translation: В домике было уютно, в углу горел огонь.

definition: in a way that relates to the arts, customs and beliefs of a society
sentence: The city is {culturally} rich, with theatres on every street.
translation: Город богат культурой, театры на каждой улице.

definition: showing a lack of respect
sentence: It is {disrespectful} to talk while the teacher is explaining.
translation: Невежливо разговаривать, пока учитель объясняет.

definition: all the people in a country or area who are allowed to vote
sentence: Only half the {electorate} bothered to vote.
translation: Проголосовать потрудилась лишь половина избирателей.

definition: the gradual wearing away of land by wind, water or ice
sentence: Coastal {erosion} takes a metre of the cliff every year.
translation: Прибрежная эрозия съедает по метру скалы каждый год.

definition: made by a person using their hands, not by a machine
sentence: The {handmade} bowl cost more than the whole set from the shop.
translation: Миска ручной работы стоила дороже, чем весь набор из магазина.

definition: the number of times something, especially a disease, happens
sentence: The {incidence} of flu doubles in the first week of January.
translation: Заболеваемость гриппом удваивается в первую неделю января.

definition: a close personal relationship, or a private friendly atmosphere
sentence: The {intimacy} of the small theatre makes every seat feel close to the stage.
translation: Камерность маленького театра создаёт ощущение, что каждое место рядом со сценой.

definition: the distance a vehicle has travelled, or the number of miles it does per gallon
sentence: The car has a low {mileage} for its age, only forty thousand.
translation: У машины небольшой пробег для её возраста, всего сорок тысяч.

definition: the ancient stories of a culture about gods and heroes
sentence: In Greek {mythology}, Zeus is the king of the gods.
translation: В греческой мифологии Зевс — царь богов.

definition: a gas that glows red when electricity passes through it, used in signs
sentence: The {neon} sign above the bar flickered all night.
translation: Неоновая вывеска над баром мерцала всю ночь.

definition: in or from the north-east of a place
sentence: The {northeastern} coast gets the first snow of the year.
translation: Северо-восточное побережье первым получает снег в году.

definition: relating to the substances in food that keep you healthy
sentence: Read the {nutritional} information on the packet before you buy.
translation: Прочитай информацию о пищевой ценности на упаковке, прежде чем покупать.

definition: seeming likely to be true or reasonable
sentence: Her excuse was {plausible}, so the teacher let her go.
translation: Её оправдание звучало правдоподобно, и учитель её отпустил.

definition: rain, snow or hail that falls to the ground
sentence: The desert gets less than ten centimetres of {precipitation} a year.
translation: В пустыне выпадает меньше десяти сантиметров осадков в год.

definition: a bright red colour
sentence: The leaves turn {scarlet} in the first cold week of autumn.
translation: В первую холодную неделю осени листья становятся алыми.

definition: in or from the south-west of a place
sentence: The {southwestern} desert is hotter than anywhere else in the country.
translation: Юго-западная пустыня жарче любого другого места в стране.

definition: a person who speaks for an organisation or group
sentence: A {spokesperson} for the airline apologised for the delays.
translation: Представитель авиакомпании извинился за задержки.

definition: to make all things of one type the same
sentence: The company wants to {standardize} its forms across every office.
translation: Компания хочет унифицировать свои бланки во всех офисах.

definition: a ruler of a Muslim country, especially in the past
sentence: The {sultan} built a palace with three hundred rooms.
translation: Султан построил дворец с тремя сотнями комнат.

definition: the state of being the most powerful or the best
sentence: The team's {supremacy} in the league lasted five years.
translation: Господство команды в лиге длилось пять лет.

definition: according to theory, though perhaps not in practice
sentence: {Theoretically} the train takes two hours, but it is always late.
translation: Теоретически поезд идёт два часа, но он всегда опаздывает.

definition: the feeling of needing to drink, or a strong wish for something
sentence: After the long climb, their {thirst} was terrible.
translation: После долгого подъёма их мучила ужасная жажда.

definition: relating to a period of change from one state to another
sentence: A {transitional} government will run the country until the election.
translation: Переходное правительство будет управлять страной до выборов.

definition: a large sea fish eaten as food, often sold in tins
sentence: She made a sandwich with {tuna} and sweetcorn.
translation: Она сделала бутерброд с тунцом и кукурузой.

definition: not being used at the moment, or never used
sentence: An {unused} room at the back became the office.
translation: Неиспользуемая комната в глубине дома стала кабинетом.

definition: a sour liquid made from wine or apples, used in cooking
sentence: Mix oil and {vinegar} for a simple salad dressing.
translation: Смешай масло и уксус для простой заправки к салату.

definition: a line of people or vehicles moving slowly as part of a ceremony
sentence: The funeral {procession} passed slowly through the village.
translation: Похоронная процессия медленно прошла через деревню.

definition: a piece of rock from space that burns brightly as it falls to Earth
sentence: A {meteor} streaked across the sky and vanished.
translation: Метеор прочертил небо и исчез.

definition: a small line in the skin that comes with age, or a fold in cloth
sentence: She has a {wrinkle} at the corner of each eye when she smiles.
translation: Когда она улыбается, у уголков глаз появляются морщинки.

definition: a secret store of something, especially money or drugs
sentence: Police found a {stash} of cash under the floorboards.
translation: Полиция нашла тайник с наличными под половицами.

definition: a group of people or companies that work together for a shared purpose, often illegal
sentence: The drugs were smuggled by an international crime {syndicate}.
translation: Наркотики переправлял международный преступный синдикат.

definition: catching or stopping something on its way, especially a pass in a game
sentence: The defender's {interception} stopped the attack at once.
translation: Перехват защитника сразу остановил атаку.

definition: a sign that something exists or is happening
sentence: The rash is a {manifestation} of the allergy.
translation: Сыпь — проявление аллергии.

definition: a printed form from a bank that you sign to pay someone
sentence: Grandma still pays the gas bill by {cheque}.
translation: Бабушка до сих пор оплачивает газ чеком.

definition: a small piece of metal that carries electricity into or out of something
sentence: The nurse placed an {electrode} on each side of his chest.
translation: Медсестра прикрепила электрод с каждой стороны его груди.

definition: to touch someone lightly so they laugh, or to amuse someone
sentence: The baby laughs whenever you {tickle} her feet.
translation: Малышка смеётся, когда ей щекочут пятки.

definition: a wild animal like a small wolf that lives in North America
sentence: A {coyote} howled in the hills behind the ranch.
translation: Койот выл в холмах за ранчо.

definition: to look at someone in an angry way, or to shine very brightly
sentence: She could only {glare} at the boy who had broken the window.
translation: Она лишь гневно смотрела на мальчика, разбившего окно.

definition: to make someone calmer, or to make a pain less
sentence: A warm bath will {soothe} the aching muscles.
translation: Тёплая ванна успокоит ноющие мышцы.

definition: a pattern or idea that is repeated in a piece of art, music or writing
sentence: A bird {motif} runs through every chapter of the novel.
translation: Мотив птицы проходит через каждую главу романа.

definition: a club of male students at a US college, or a group with shared interests
sentence: He joined a {fraternity} in his first year at college.
translation: На первом курсе колледжа он вступил в студенческое братство.

definition: a flat boat made of logs or rubber, or a large number of things
sentence: We crossed the river on a {raft} of tied logs.
translation: Мы переправились через реку на плоту из связанных брёвен.

definition: the open space in a wall where a fire is lit to heat a room
sentence: The cat sleeps in front of the {fireplace} all winter.
translation: Кот всю зиму спит перед камином.

definition: to block something so that nothing can pass through
sentence: Leaves will {clog} the drain if you do not clear them.
translation: Листья забьют водосток, если их не убрать.

definition: a long flat boat used for carrying goods on rivers and canals
sentence: A {barge} loaded with coal moved slowly up the canal.
translation: Баржа, гружённая углём, медленно шла по каналу.

definition: to ask for information
sentence: I called to {inquire} about the price of the tickets.
translation: Я позвонил узнать цену билетов.

definition: to fight by holding and throwing someone, or to struggle with a problem
sentence: The two boys began to {wrestle} on the grass.
translation: Два мальчика стали бороться на траве.

definition: the main female character in a story, or a woman admired for her courage
sentence: The {heroine} of the novel escapes from the castle at midnight.
translation: Героиня романа сбегает из замка в полночь.

definition: the baseball player who crouches behind the batter to catch the ball
sentence: The {catcher} signalled for a fast ball.
translation: Кетчер подал знак бросить быстрый мяч.

definition: a person who looks after passengers on a ship or plane, or who manages property
sentence: The {steward} brought us blankets for the night flight.
translation: Стюард принёс нам пледы на ночной рейс.

definition: to plant seeds in the ground
sentence: Farmers {sow} the wheat in October and harvest it in July.
translation: Фермеры сеют пшеницу в октябре и убирают в июле.

definition: a person who tests students or checks something officially
sentence: The {examiner} asked her to park between two cars.
translation: Экзаменатор попросил её припарковаться между двумя машинами.

definition: a violent storm with strong winds that turn in a circle
sentence: The {cyclone} tore roofs off houses along the coast.
translation: Циклон сорвал крыши с домов вдоль побережья.

definition: to produce new leaves or shoots, or to start to grow
sentence: The seeds will {sprout} within a week if you keep them warm.
translation: Семена прорастут за неделю, если держать их в тепле.

definition: to explode and throw out lava, or to start suddenly and violently
sentence: The volcano could {erupt} again at any time.
translation: Вулкан может снова извергнуться в любой момент.

definition: a person whose job is to take money from customers in a shop or bank
sentence: The {cashier} counted the change twice before handing it over.
translation: Кассир дважды пересчитала сдачу, прежде чем отдать.

definition: too much of a drug taken at one time
sentence: He was rushed to hospital after an {overdose} of sleeping pills.
translation: Его срочно доставили в больницу после передозировки снотворного.

definition: a woman who serves food and drink at tables in a restaurant
sentence: The {waitress} remembered our order without writing it down.
translation: Официантка запомнила наш заказ, не записывая.

definition: to throw something with force and without care
sentence: He would {fling} his coat on the chair and head straight for the kitchen.
translation: Он швырял пальто на стул и сразу шёл на кухню.

definition: a funny television series about the same group of people in each episode
sentence: The {sitcom} about the flatmates ran for ten seasons.
translation: Ситком о соседях по квартире шёл десять сезонов.

definition: to think again about a plan or idea and possibly change it
sentence: The flood forced the council to {rethink} the whole housing plan.
translation: Наводнение заставило совет пересмотреть весь план застройки.

definition: a ship or truck that carries large amounts of liquid such as oil
sentence: The oil {tanker} waited outside the harbour for a free berth.
translation: Нефтяной танкер ждал у входа в гавань свободного причала.

definition: in an angry or forceful way, or with great energy
sentence: The dog barked {aggressively} at everyone who passed the gate.
translation: Собака агрессивно лаяла на всех, кто проходил мимо ворот.

definition: an official decision to free prisoners or forgive crimes
sentence: The new president declared an {amnesty} for political prisoners.
translation: Новый президент объявил амнистию политическим заключённым.

definition: the scientific study of stars, planets and space
sentence: She took up {astronomy} after her father gave her a telescope.
translation: Она увлеклась астрономией после того, как отец подарил ей телескоп.

definition: on top of something
sentence: A small flag flew {atop} the tower.
translation: Маленький флаг развевался на вершине башни.

definition: a room or space just under the roof of a house
sentence: The old photographs are in a box in the {attic}.
translation: Старые фотографии лежат в коробке на чердаке.

definition: the story of a person's life written by that person
sentence: The singer's {autobiography} sold a million copies in a month.
translation: Автобиография певицы разошлась миллионным тиражом за месяц.

definition: clear and logical, with all the parts connected well
sentence: After three coffees I could finally give a {coherent} answer.
translation: После трёх чашек кофе я наконец смог ответить связно.

definition: nice to sit or lie on, or to wear, in informal speech
sentence: Sit in the {comfy} chair by the window.
translation: Сядь в удобное кресло у окна.

definition: not straight, or dishonest
sentence: The picture on the wall is {crooked}; straighten it, please.
translation: Картина на стене висит криво, поправь её, пожалуйста.

definition: the growing of plants or crops, or the development of a skill
sentence: The {cultivation} of rice needs flat fields full of water.
translation: Выращивание риса требует ровных полей, залитых водой.

definition: forcing people out of their homes, or moving something from its place
sentence: The war caused the {displacement} of two million people.
translation: Война вынудила два миллиона человек покинуть свои дома.

definition: extreme and sudden, with a strong effect
sentence: The hospital took {drastic} action and closed three wards.
translation: Больница приняла радикальные меры и закрыла три отделения.

definition: a copy of a document sent by telephone line, or the machine that sends it
sentence: The office still receives one {fax} a week from an old client.
translation: Офис до сих пор получает один факс в неделю от старого клиента.

definition: extremely large
sentence: A {gigantic} wave rose above the small boat.
translation: Гигантская волна поднялась над маленькой лодкой.

definition: the short break in the middle of a sports match
sentence: The coach made two changes at {halftime}.
translation: В перерыве тренер сделал две замены.

definition: the sign #, or a dish of meat and potatoes cut small and fried
sentence: Type a {hash} before the word to make it a tag.
translation: Поставь решётку перед словом, чтобы сделать его тегом.

definition: not doing anything, or not working or operating
sentence: The volcano has been {inactive} for two hundred years.
translation: Вулкан не действует уже двести лет.

definition: the quality of being legal, fair or acceptable
sentence: The opposition questioned the {legitimacy} of the election.
translation: Оппозиция поставила под сомнение законность выборов.

definition: according to ideas of what is right and wrong
sentence: You may be legally safe, but {morally} you were wrong.
translation: Юридически ты, может, и чист, но морально был не прав.

definition: without violence or trouble, or calmly
sentence: The crowd marched {peacefully} through the city centre.
translation: Толпа мирно прошла через центр города.

definition: happening regularly after fixed intervals
sentence: The bridge needs {periodic} checks for rust.
translation: Мост нуждается в периодических проверках на ржавчину.

definition: a small raised platform that a speaker or winner stands on
sentence: The three fastest runners climbed onto the {podium}.
translation: Три самых быстрых бегуна поднялись на пьедестал.

definition: the hard flat black disc hit by the players in ice hockey
sentence: The {puck} flew past the goalkeeper into the net.
translation: Шайба пролетела мимо вратаря в ворота.

definition: a strong alcoholic drink made from sugar cane
sentence: The sailors were given a glass of {rum} every evening.
translation: Морякам каждый вечер выдавали по стакану рома.

definition: a trip to see or hunt wild animals, especially in Africa
sentence: On {safari} we saw lions, elephants and a leopard.
translation: На сафари мы видели львов, слонов и леопарда.

definition: almost never
sentence: My grandfather {seldom} leaves the house in winter.
translation: Мой дедушка зимой редко выходит из дома.

definition: a plant whose beans are used to make oil, milk and a dark salty sauce
sentence: She drinks {soy} milk because cow's milk makes her ill.
translation: Она пьёт соевое молоко, потому что от коровьего ей плохо.

definition: happening or existing across a whole state of the USA
sentence: The {statewide} ban on plastic bags starts in January.
translation: Запрет на пластиковые пакеты по всему штату начнётся в январе.

definition: not moving
sentence: The car hit a {stationary} lorry at the side of the road.
translation: Машина врезалась в стоящий грузовик на обочине.

definition: a thick black sticky substance used on roads and roofs
sentence: The hot {tar} on the new road stuck to our shoes.
translation: Горячая смола на новой дороге прилипала к обуви.

definition: relating to time, or to this world rather than religion
sentence: The film jumps between three {temporal} layers: past, present and future.
translation: Фильм перескакивает между тремя временными слоями: прошлым, настоящим и будущим.

definition: not able to be used, bought or spoken to
sentence: The manager is {unavailable} until Monday.
translation: Менеджер недоступен до понедельника.

definition: by everyone, or in every case
sentence: The decision was {universally} welcomed by the staff.
translation: Решение было единодушно встречено сотрудниками.

definition: having or bringing bad luck
sentence: It was {unlucky} that the only rainy day was the wedding day.
translation: Не повезло, что единственный дождливый день пришёлся на свадьбу.

definition: the organ in a woman's body where a baby grows before birth
sentence: The baby turns inside the {womb} in the last weeks.
translation: В последние недели ребёнок переворачивается в утробе.

definition: a thick slightly sour food made from milk with bacteria added
sentence: She eats {yogurt} with honey and nuts for breakfast.
translation: На завтрак она ест йогурт с мёдом и орехами.

definition: to take advantage of a situation, or to write with a capital letter
sentence: The shop hopes to {capitalize} on the festival crowds.
translation: Магазин надеется извлечь выгоду из фестивальной толпы.

definition: a death caused by an accident, war or disease
sentence: The crash on the motorway caused one {fatality} and six injuries.
translation: Авария на автомагистрали привела к одной гибели и шести ранениям.

definition: a hill of sand made by the wind on a beach or in a desert
sentence: We climbed the highest {dune} to watch the sunset.
translation: Мы поднялись на самую высокую дюну, чтобы встретить закат.

definition: formal questioning of someone, especially by the police
sentence: After six hours of {interrogation} he admitted the theft.
translation: После шести часов допроса он признался в краже.

definition: a sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and a large stone
sentence: The {mango} was so ripe that juice ran down my arm.
translation: Манго было такое спелое, что сок стекал по руке.

definition: a small shop that sells fashionable clothes or expensive goods
sentence: She opened a {boutique} selling dresses made by local designers.
translation: Она открыла бутик с платьями местных дизайнеров.

definition: a dog used for hunting
sentence: The {hound} followed the scent through the wet forest.
translation: Гончая шла по следу через мокрый лес.

definition: a fixed amount of food or fuel that each person is allowed in a shortage
sentence: During the war the weekly {ration} of butter was fifty grams.
translation: Во время войны недельная норма масла составляла пятьдесят граммов.

definition: to make or become wider or more general
sentence: Travel will {broaden} your view of the world.
translation: Путешествия расширят твой взгляд на мир.

definition: a material such as silicon that lets electricity pass partly, used in chips
sentence: The country's biggest {semiconductor} factory makes chips for phones.
translation: Крупнейший в стране завод полупроводников делает чипы для телефонов.

definition: a smaller group that is part of a larger group
sentence: Teenagers are a {subset} of the population with its own habits.
translation: Подростки — часть населения со своими привычками.

definition: a colour or a particular shade of a colour
sentence: The sky turned a strange orange {hue} before the storm.
translation: Перед бурей небо приобрело странный оранжевый оттенок.

definition: an object or pattern cut from wood or stone
sentence: A {carving} of a horse stood on the shelf.
translation: На полке стояла резная фигурка лошади.

definition: a young person training to become an officer in the army or police
sentence: Every {cadet} must run five kilometres before breakfast.
translation: Каждый курсант должен пробежать пять километров до завтрака.

definition: a flying insect with black and yellow stripes that can sting
sentence: A {wasp} landed on the jam and nobody dared to move it.
translation: Оса села на варенье, и никто не решался её согнать.

definition: a machine for mixing food, or a drink added to alcohol
sentence: Beat the eggs and sugar with an electric {mixer}.
translation: Взбей яйца с сахаром электрическим миксером.

definition: a member of a jury in a court
sentence: Each {juror} swore to judge the case fairly.
translation: Каждый присяжный поклялся судить дело справедливо.

definition: a long flat piece of wood
sentence: He laid a {plank} across the stream as a bridge.
translation: Он положил доску через ручей вместо моста.

definition: a person whose job is to amuse people, such as a singer or comedian
sentence: The {entertainer} kept the children laughing for an hour.
translation: Артист целый час смешил детей.

definition: a small problem that stops a machine or program from working properly
sentence: A {glitch} in the app charged some customers twice.
translation: Из-за сбоя в приложении с некоторых клиентов деньги списали дважды.

definition: a dishonest person or criminal
sentence: The old {crook} sold the same car to three buyers.
translation: Старый жулик продал одну и ту же машину трём покупателям.

definition: a car with four doors and a separate boot, in American English
sentence: He traded his sports car for a family {sedan}.
translation: Он сменил спортивную машину на семейный седан.

definition: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering
sentence: The dam's collapse was a {catastrophe} for the villages below.
translation: Обрушение плотины стало катастрофой для деревень ниже по течению.

definition: very small drops of liquid in the air, such as steam
sentence: Water {vapor} rose from the hot pool in the cold morning air.
translation: Водяной пар поднимался от горячего бассейна в холодном утреннем воздухе.

definition: a person or company that grows fruit, vegetables or flowers to sell
sentence: The local {grower} supplies the market with strawberries all summer.
translation: Местный фермер всё лето поставляет на рынок клубнику.

definition: an animal from Australia that jumps and carries its baby in a pocket
sentence: A {kangaroo} crossed the road in front of the car at dusk.
translation: В сумерках перед машиной дорогу перебежал кенгуру.

definition: a glass tank for keeping fish, or a building where fish are shown
sentence: The children pressed their faces to the {aquarium} glass.
translation: Дети прижались лицами к стеклу аквариума.

definition: one part or feature of something that has many parts
sentence: Every {facet} of the plan was checked before the launch.
translation: Каждый аспект плана проверили перед запуском.

definition: to escape from or avoid something, often by being clever
sentence: The thief managed to {evade} the police for a week.
translation: Вору удавалось скрываться от полиции неделю.

definition: the way a product is mixed, or the way an idea is expressed
sentence: The new {formulation} of the cream contains no perfume.
translation: Новый состав крема не содержит отдушки.

definition: operating in several countries
sentence: A {multinational} company bought the local brewery.
translation: Транснациональная компания купила местную пивоварню.

definition: to make something less tight or firm
sentence: {Loosen} the screw a little before you pull the handle off.
translation: Ослабь винт немного, прежде чем снимать ручку.

definition: to arrange a meeting, or to come together for one
sentence: The president will {convene} the council to discuss the flood.
translation: Президент созовёт совет, чтобы обсудить наводнение.

definition: unable to feel anything, often because of cold or shock
sentence: My fingers went {numb} after an hour in the snow.
translation: После часа на снегу у меня онемели пальцы.

definition: to build something again, or to work out how an event happened
sentence: Police tried to {reconstruct} the crash from the marks on the road.
translation: Полиция пыталась восстановить картину аварии по следам на дороге.

definition: to take a person away by force
sentence: The men tried to {abduct} the businessman outside his office.
translation: Мужчины пытались похитить бизнесмена у его офиса.

definition: the way a person or thing is shown in a film, book or picture
sentence: Her {portrayal} of the queen won every acting prize that year.
translation: Её исполнение роли королевы получило все актёрские награды того года.

definition: a large difference between things that should be equal
sentence: There is a wide {disparity} in pay between the two factories.
translation: Между двумя заводами большой разрыв в зарплатах.

definition: a person who takes money from a bank and promises to pay it back
sentence: The bank checks every {borrower} before it lends a cent.
translation: Банк проверяет каждого заёмщика, прежде чем дать хоть цент.

definition: to travel across or through an area
sentence: It took the team six weeks to {traverse} the ice sheet.
translation: Команде понадобилось шесть недель, чтобы пересечь ледяной щит.

definition: a person who lives in a house or is in a vehicle or seat
sentence: Every {occupant} of the car was wearing a seat belt.
translation: Все находившиеся в машине были пристёгнуты.

definition: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps
sentence: Small {alpine} flowers grow between the rocks above the snow line.
translation: Маленькие альпийские цветы растут между камнями выше снеговой линии.

definition: relating to the surrounding area or conditions
sentence: The {ambient} temperature in the cave stays at ten degrees all year.
translation: Температура воздуха в пещере круглый год держится на десяти градусах.

definition: living or happening in or near water
sentence: Frogs are {aquatic} animals for the first part of their lives.
translation: Лягушки в первой части жизни — водные животные.

definition: protected by metal plates, used of vehicles and soldiers
sentence: An {armored} truck carries the money to the bank every Friday.
translation: Бронированный грузовик каждую пятницу перевозит деньги в банк.

definition: the amount of data a connection can carry, or the time and energy someone has
sentence: Video calls need more {bandwidth} than voice calls.
translation: Видеозвонки требуют большей пропускной способности, чем голосовые.

definition: a meal cooked outdoors on a metal frame over a fire, or the frame itself
sentence: We had a {barbecue} in the garden on the last warm evening.
translation: В последний тёплый вечер мы устроили барбекю в саду.

definition: before something happens, in advance
sentence: Book the table {beforehand}; the place fills up by seven.
translation: Забронируй столик заранее, к семи там уже полно.

definition: having a mental condition with periods of great energy and periods of deep sadness
sentence: Her doctor diagnosed a {bipolar} disorder when she was twenty.
translation: Врач поставил ей диагноз биполярного расстройства в двадцать лет.

definition: the organ in the body where urine collects before it leaves
sentence: Drink less coffee if your {bladder} wakes you at night.
translation: Пей меньше кофе, если мочевой пузырь будит тебя по ночам.

definition: using computers or calculation
sentence: The {computational} power of a phone today beats a 1990s supercomputer.
translation: Вычислительная мощность сегодняшнего телефона превосходит суперкомпьютер 1990-х.

definition: relating to ideas rather than to practical things
sentence: The plan is still at a {conceptual} stage with no budget attached.
translation: План пока на концептуальной стадии, без бюджета.

definition: an amount of money taken out of a bank account
sentence: A monthly {debit} pays the electricity bill automatically.
translation: Ежемесячное списание автоматически оплачивает счёт за электричество.

definition: the act of pulling down a building on purpose
sentence: The {demolition} of the old stadium took three weeks.
translation: Снос старого стадиона занял три недели.

definition: in the direction that a river flows
sentence: The boat drifted {downstream} towards the bridge.
translation: Лодку понесло вниз по течению к мосту.

definition: based on what is observed or experienced rather than on theory
sentence: There is no {empirical} evidence that the cream slows ageing.
translation: Нет эмпирических доказательств, что крем замедляет старение.

definition: not working correctly or made badly
sentence: The fire was caused by a {faulty} cable behind the fridge.
translation: Пожар возник из-за неисправного кабеля за холодильником.

definition: able to produce good crops, or able to have babies
sentence: The valley's {fertile} soil gives two harvests a year.
translation: Плодородная почва долины даёт два урожая в год.

definition: too much worry or noise about something small
sentence: Don't make a {fuss}, it's just a small scratch.
translation: Не поднимай шум, это всего лишь царапина.

definition: willingness to give money, time or help freely
sentence: Thanks to the {generosity} of local shops, every child got a present.
translation: Благодаря щедрости местных магазинов каждый ребёнок получил подарок.

definition: a part of some grains that makes bread soft and easy to pull
sentence: The bakery sells bread without {gluten} for people who cannot eat it.
translation: Пекарня продаёт хлеб без глютена для тех, кому он противопоказан.

definition: a boxer in the heaviest class, or a very important person or thing
sentence: The {heavyweight} champion defended his title for the sixth time.
translation: Чемпион в тяжёлом весе защитил титул в шестой раз.

definition: showing kindness and care for people and animals
sentence: The shelter looks for a {humane} way to control the stray cats.
translation: Приют ищет гуманный способ контролировать бездомных кошек.

definition: allowed by the law
sentence: Protest is {lawful} as long as it stays peaceful.
translation: Протест законен, пока остаётся мирным.

definition: not tightly, or not exactly
sentence: The scarf hung {loosely} around her neck.
translation: Шарф свободно висел у неё на шее.

definition: a water plant with large pink or white flowers, important in Asian religions
sentence: A pink {lotus} floated on the still water of the pond.
translation: Розовый лотос плавал на неподвижной воде пруда.

definition: the layer of the Earth below the surface, or a role passed on to someone
sentence: Hot rock in the {mantle} moves slowly beneath the continents.
translation: Горячая порода в мантии медленно движется под континентами.

definition: relating to the chemical processes that turn food into energy
sentence: A slow {metabolic} rate makes it harder to lose weight.
translation: Медленный обмен веществ затрудняет похудение.

definition: the central area of a football pitch, or the players who play there
sentence: The team controlled the {midfield} for the whole second half.
translation: Команда контролировала центр поля всю вторую половину.

definition: a feeling of pleasure and sadness when you remember the past
sentence: The old songs filled him with {nostalgia} for his school days.
translation: Старые песни наполнили его ностальгией по школьным годам.

definition: a book with a soft paper cover
sentence: The {paperback} costs half the price of the hardback.
translation: Книга в мягкой обложке стоит вдвое дешевле, чем в твёрдой.

definition: a light building in a park or at a sports ground
sentence: The team changed in the wooden {pavilion} beside the cricket pitch.
translation: Команда переодевалась в деревянном павильоне рядом с полем для крикета.

definition: having four straight sides and four right angles
sentence: The garden is {rectangular}, twenty metres by ten.
translation: Сад прямоугольный, двадцать метров на десять.

definition: saying the opposite of what you mean to mock someone
sentence: 'Great job,' she said with heavy {sarcasm} as he dropped the plates.
translation: «Отличная работа», — сказала она с тяжёлым сарказмом, когда он уронил тарелки.

definition: treating people unfairly because of their sex, especially women
sentence: The {sexist} comment about women drivers got him sacked.
translation: Сексистское замечание о женщинах-водителях стоило ему работы.

definition: the closing of a factory, business or system, for a time or for ever
sentence: The {shutdown} of the mine put a thousand people out of work.
translation: Закрытие шахты оставило без работы тысячу человек.

definition: with everyone agreeing
sentence: The committee voted {unanimously} to keep the library open.
translation: Комитет единогласно проголосовал за то, чтобы оставить библиотеку открытой.

definition: never having lost a match or fight
sentence: The boxer retired {undefeated} after forty fights.
translation: Боксёр ушёл непобеждённым после сорока боёв.

definition: not known to you, or not knowing something
sentence: She woke up in an {unfamiliar} room with no idea where she was.
translation: Она проснулась в незнакомой комнате, не понимая, где находится.

definition: to a very great degree
sentence: The new bridge is {vastly} better than the old ferry.
translation: Новый мост несравнимо лучше старого парома.

definition: extremely bad or disgusting
sentence: A {vile} smell came from the blocked drain.
translation: Из забитого стока шёл отвратительный запах.

definition: with great force, or in a way that causes injury
sentence: The boat rocked {violently} in the storm.
translation: Лодку сильно качало в шторм.

definition: in a way that shows good judgement
sentence: She {wisely} kept her savings in two different banks.
translation: Она благоразумно держала сбережения в двух разных банках.

definition: a piece of equipment that makes sound or an electrical signal stronger
sentence: The guitarist turned up the {amplifier} until the windows shook.
translation: Гитарист выкрутил усилитель так, что задрожали окна.

definition: to delight someone greatly, or to put a magic spell on them
sentence: The old town will {enchant} anyone who walks its streets at dusk.
translation: Старый город очарует любого, кто пройдёт по его улицам в сумерках.

definition: a person who supports an idea or plan
sentence: She is a leading {proponent} of free school meals.
translation: Она ведущий сторонник бесплатных школьных обедов.

definition: a long bomb fired under water from a ship or submarine
sentence: The {torpedo} struck the ship below the water line.
translation: Торпеда поразила корабль ниже ватерлинии.

definition: a drug that makes you sleepy or stops pain, often illegal
sentence: Police found a {narcotic} hidden in the lining of the suitcase.
translation: Полиция нашла наркотик, спрятанный в подкладке чемодана.

definition: a device that connects computers in a home or office to the internet
sentence: Restart the {router} if the internet stops working.
translation: Перезагрузи роутер, если интернет перестанет работать.

definition: to flow over the edge of a container, or to be too full
sentence: The river will {overflow} its banks if the rain goes on.
translation: Река выйдет из берегов, если дождь продолжится.

definition: something that blocks a road or passage, or the act of blocking something
sentence: A fallen tree caused an {obstruction} on the main road.
translation: Упавшее дерево перегородило главную дорогу.

definition: to think carefully about something for a long time
sentence: He sat by the river to {ponder} the offer.
translation: Он сел у реки, чтобы обдумать предложение.

definition: a small bag that a woman carries her money, keys and other things in
sentence: She searched her {handbag} for the train ticket.
translation: Она искала в сумочке билет на поезд.

definition: a mass of hair or thin lines all mixed and knotted together
sentence: The cables behind the television were a hopeless {tangle}.
translation: Провода за телевизором были безнадёжно спутаны.

definition: a baby or animal in the first weeks of growing inside the mother
sentence: The {embryo} develops a heartbeat in the sixth week.
translation: У эмбриона на шестой неделе появляется сердцебиение.

definition: a round handle on a door or drawer, or a round control on a machine
sentence: Turn the {knob} to the right to make the radio louder.
translation: Поверни ручку вправо, чтобы сделать радио громче.

definition: to make someone unable to see because of bright light, or to impress them greatly
sentence: The sun on the snow will {dazzle} you without sunglasses.
translation: Солнце на снегу ослепит тебя без солнцезащитных очков.

definition: a tall tower with a bright light that warns ships of danger
sentence: The {lighthouse} on the rocks has guided ships for two hundred years.
translation: Маяк на скалах два века направляет корабли.

definition: to cover something to stop heat, sound or electricity passing through
sentence: We need to {insulate} the roof before winter.
translation: Нам нужно утеплить крышу до зимы.

definition: a small soft red fruit that grows on a bush
sentence: She picked a {raspberry} from the bush and ate it.
translation: Она сорвала малину с куста и съела.

definition: a number that multiplies a quantity in a formula, or shows a property
sentence: The {coefficient} of friction tells you how slippery a surface is.
translation: Коэффициент трения показывает, насколько скользкая поверхность.

definition: a brightly coloured tropical bird that can copy human speech
sentence: The {parrot} repeated every word the captain said.
translation: Попугай повторял каждое слово капитана.

definition: the bad part of a situation that is otherwise good
sentence: The {downside} of the flat is the noise from the road.
translation: Минус квартиры — шум с дороги.

definition: to gather soldiers together, or to find enough courage or strength
sentence: She could not {muster} the courage to open the letter.
translation: Она не смогла собраться с духом, чтобы открыть письмо.

definition: a word such as 'she' or 'it' used instead of a noun
sentence: In 'She loves him', both words are a {pronoun}.
translation: В «She loves him» оба слова — местоимения.

definition: the space in a wall where a door opens
sentence: A tall man stood in the {doorway} and blocked the light.
translation: В дверном проёме стоял высокий мужчина и загораживал свет.

definition: the way something is shown in a picture, film or description
sentence: The film's {depiction} of village life is too pretty to be true.
translation: Изображение деревенской жизни в фильме слишком красиво, чтобы быть правдой.

definition: to secretly join an organisation or enter a place to get information
sentence: A police officer managed to {infiltrate} the gang.
translation: Полицейскому удалось внедриться в банду.

definition: to make a process simpler and more efficient
sentence: The new software will {streamline} the way we handle orders.
translation: Новая программа упростит обработку заказов.

definition: to dip food into a drink, or to push a ball down through the basket
sentence: I like to {dunk} a biscuit in my tea.
translation: Я люблю макать печенье в чай.

definition: to cover food or pottery with a thin shiny layer
sentence: {Glaze} the pastry with egg before it goes in the oven.
translation: Смажь тесто яйцом, прежде чем ставить в духовку.

definition: a tall pole on a ship that holds the sails
sentence: The sailor climbed the {mast} to free the stuck sail.
translation: Моряк залез на мачту, чтобы освободить застрявший парус.

definition: to die, especially in an accident or in hard conditions
sentence: Many climbers {perish} on the mountain every year.
translation: Каждый год на этой горе гибнет много альпинистов.

definition: a false belief that a person holds firmly despite the facts
sentence: He lived under the {delusion} that the whole town loved him.
translation: Он жил в заблуждении, что весь город его любит.

definition: a small thin book with a paper cover that gives information
sentence: The {booklet} explains how to use the washing machine.
translation: В брошюре объясняется, как пользоваться стиральной машиной.

definition: a nice smell, or a liquid you put on your skin to smell nice
sentence: The {fragrance} of roses filled the summer evening.
translation: Аромат роз наполнял летний вечер.

definition: a slow song that tells a story, often about love
sentence: The band ended the concert with a quiet {ballad}.
translation: Группа закончила концерт тихой балладой.

definition: a person who develops ideas to explain something
sentence: The {theorist} spent years on an idea nobody could test.
translation: Теоретик годами работал над идеей, которую никто не мог проверить.

definition: able to change to suit new conditions
sentence: The {adaptive} headlights turn with the road at night.
translation: Адаптивные фары ночью поворачиваются вместе с дорогой.

definition: making you want more and unable to stop
sentence: The game is so {addictive} that she played until three in the morning.
translation: Игра настолько затягивает, что она играла до трёх ночи.

definition: a natural liking for or understanding of someone or something
sentence: She felt an immediate {affinity} with the old fisherman.
translation: Она сразу почувствовала близость к старому рыбаку.

definition: the former South African system that separated people by race
sentence: Under {apartheid}, black and white children went to different schools.
translation: При апартеиде чёрные и белые дети ходили в разные школы.

definition: a disease that makes the joints swollen and painful
sentence: Her {arthritis} makes it hard to open jars.
translation: Из-за артрита ей трудно открывать банки.

definition: a building where trials are held
sentence: Reporters waited outside the {courthouse} for the verdict.
translation: Журналисты ждали у здания суда вердикта.

definition: the official ending of a marriage, parliament or organisation
sentence: The {dissolution} of parliament starts the election campaign.
translation: Роспуск парламента начинает избирательную кампанию.

definition: belonging to a Christian group that stresses the Bible and personal faith
sentence: The {evangelical} church on the corner fills up every Sunday.
translation: Евангелическая церковь на углу по воскресеньям полна.

definition: extremely beautiful and delicate
sentence: The bride wore an {exquisite} lace veil made by her grandmother.
translation: На невесте была изысканная кружевная фата, сделанная её бабушкой.

definition: based on facts rather than opinions
sentence: The report is {factual} and leaves the reader to judge.
translation: Отчёт основан на фактах и оставляет выводы читателю.

definition: in a way that is not true, or wrongly
sentence: He was {falsely} accused of stealing from the shop.
translation: Его ложно обвинили в краже из магазина.

definition: a situation in which many people have little or no food for a long time
sentence: The {famine} killed a million people in three years.
translation: Голод унёс миллион жизней за три года.

definition: intended to cheat people, usually to get money
sentence: The bank closed the account after finding {fraudulent} payments.
translation: Банк закрыл счёт, обнаружив мошеннические платежи.

definition: recently, used about something just made or done
sentence: The smell of {freshly} baked bread filled the street.
translation: Запах свежеиспечённого хлеба наполнил улицу.

definition: something said or done to show respect for a person or their work
sentence: The concert was a {homage} to the singer who died last year.
translation: Концерт был данью уважения певцу, умершему в прошлом году.

definition: based on a possible idea or situation rather than on facts
sentence: Let me ask a {hypothetical} question: what if the bridge closed?
translation: Задам гипотетический вопрос: а если бы мост закрыли?

definition: giving useful information
sentence: The guide's talk was short but very {informative}.
translation: Рассказ экскурсовода был коротким, но очень информативным.

definition: an action that breaks a law or someone's rights
sentence: Copying the song without permission is a copyright {infringement}.
translation: Копирование песни без разрешения — нарушение авторских прав.

definition: a climbing plant with small white flowers and a sweet smell
sentence: The scent of {jasmine} drifted in through the open window.
translation: Аромат жасмина вплывал в открытое окно.

definition: a blow in boxing that makes the other fighter unable to get up
sentence: The fight ended with a {knockout} in the second round.
translation: Бой закончился нокаутом во втором раунде.

definition: a person who watches for danger, or a place from which you can watch
sentence: The {lookout} on the mast shouted when he saw land.
translation: Наблюдатель на мачте закричал, увидев землю.

definition: the light that comes from the moon at night
sentence: The lake shone silver in the {moonlight}.
translation: Озеро серебрилось в лунном свете.

definition: a very large deer with wide flat horns that lives in northern forests
sentence: A {moose} stepped out of the trees onto the road.
translation: Лось вышел из-за деревьев на дорогу.

definition: continuing forward from a particular time or place
sentence: From Monday {onwards} the shop opens at eight.
translation: С понедельника магазин открывается в восемь.

definition: the day on which you receive your wages
sentence: Rent is due the day after {payday}, which is lucky.
translation: Аренду надо платить на следующий день после зарплаты, и это удобно.

definition: continuing for ever or for a very long time without stopping
sentence: The city lives in {perpetual} noise from the airport.
translation: Город живёт в непрерывном шуме от аэропорта.

definition: the study of how the bodies of living things work
sentence: She studied {physiology} before becoming a sports doctor.
translation: Она изучала физиологию, прежде чем стать спортивным врачом.

definition: a large area of high flat land, or a period when something stops changing
sentence: The road climbs onto a {plateau} where sheep graze.
translation: Дорога поднимается на плато, где пасутся овцы.

definition: a rapid increase in the number or amount of something
sentence: The {proliferation} of coffee shops has changed the high street.
translation: Стремительный рост числа кофеен изменил главную улицу.

definition: a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal, or a soft cooked dish
sentence: For {pudding} there is apple pie or ice cream.
translation: На десерт есть яблочный пирог или мороженое.

definition: the process of making an area or thing grow or develop again
sentence: The {regeneration} of the docks brought new flats and jobs.
translation: Возрождение доков принесло новые квартиры и рабочие места.

definition: the act of remembering and honouring someone who has died
sentence: A minute of silence is held in {remembrance} of the fallen.
translation: Минуту молчания проводят в память о павших.

definition: making you remember something similar
sentence: The cafe is {reminiscent} of the Paris of the 1920s.
translation: Кафе напоминает Париж 1920-х годов.

definition: a feeling of being angry for a long time because someone treated you badly
sentence: I still feel some {resentment} about how they fired me.
translation: Я до сих пор немного обижен на то, как меня уволили.

definition: covered with the red-brown coat old iron gets, or out of practice
sentence: My French is {rusty}; I have not spoken it in years.
translation: Мой французский заржавел, я годами на нём не говорил.

definition: not easy to find, existing in small amounts
sentence: Parking is {scarce} around the stadium on match days.
translation: В дни матчей возле стадиона почти негде припарковаться.

definition: wet or smooth so that it is hard to hold or walk on
sentence: The rocks by the river are {slippery}, so hold the rail.
translation: Камни у реки скользкие, так что держись за перила.

definition: wanting to kill yourself, or extremely dangerous
sentence: Driving on that ice would be {suicidal}.
translation: Ехать по этому льду было бы самоубийством.

definition: a meeting at which experts discuss a particular subject
sentence: She presented her research at a {symposium} on climate.
translation: Она представила своё исследование на симпозиуме по климату.

definition: to think that someone or something is less good or important than they really are
sentence: Fans tend to {underrate} the defenders and praise the strikers.
translation: Болельщики склонны недооценивать защитников и хвалить нападающих.

definition: not known or not recognised
sentence: Police found an {unidentified} body in the river.
translation: Полиция нашла в реке неопознанное тело.

definition: angry or violent protest by many people
sentence: Rising bread prices led to {unrest} in the capital.
translation: Рост цен на хлеб привёл к беспорядкам в столице.

definition: not seen or noticed, or not able to be seen
sentence: The thief slipped out {unseen} through the back door.
translation: Вор незаметно выскользнул через заднюю дверь.

definition: the greatest possible
sentence: Handle the glass with the {utmost} care.
translation: Обращайся со стеклом с величайшей осторожностью.

definition: very tired, especially after working hard for a long time
sentence: The {weary} travellers reached the inn after dark.
translation: Усталые путники добрались до постоялого двора после наступления темноты.

definition: a cold-blooded animal with dry scaly skin, such as a snake or lizard
sentence: A {reptile} needs the sun to warm its body in the morning.
translation: Рептилии нужно солнце, чтобы согреть тело утром.

definition: to make something straight, or to tidy it
sentence: {Straighten} the picture; it is hanging to one side.
translation: Поправь картину, она висит криво.

definition: a container that holds food for birds, or something that supplies a larger thing
sentence: We hung a bird {feeder} outside the kitchen window.
translation: Мы повесили кормушку для птиц за кухонным окном.

definition: to tell a story, or to speak the words heard in a film
sentence: A famous actor will {narrate} the film about the Arctic.
translation: Знаменитый актёр будет читать закадровый текст в фильме об Арктике.

definition: a person who plays golf
sentence: The young {golfer} finished second in her first tournament.
translation: Юная гольфистка финишировала второй на своём первом турнире.

definition: to force someone to pay money or do something by threatening to reveal a secret
sentence: He tried to {blackmail} the minister with the old photographs.
translation: Он пытался шантажировать министра старыми фотографиями.

definition: to breathe air, smoke or gas into your lungs
sentence: Do not {inhale} the fumes from the paint.
translation: Не вдыхай пары краски.

definition: a smart jacket, often with a school or club sign on the pocket
sentence: Every pupil wears a dark blue {blazer} with the school badge.
translation: Каждый ученик носит тёмно-синий пиджак со школьной эмблемой.

definition: a person who helps someone with their work
sentence: The teacher has a {helper} who hands out the books.
translation: У учителя есть помощник, который раздаёт книги.

definition: a change in the route of traffic, or something that takes attention away
sentence: A {diversion} took us ten kilometres out of our way.
translation: Объезд увёл нас на десять километров в сторону.

definition: a bar that joins two wheels of a vehicle
sentence: The lorry broke an {axle} on the rough mountain road.
translation: Грузовик сломал ось на разбитой горной дороге.

definition: a machine that dries clothes or hair
sentence: Put the towels in the {dryer} for half an hour.
translation: Положи полотенца в сушилку на полчаса.

definition: out of control, or escaping
sentence: A {runaway} truck rolled down the hill into the river.
translation: Неуправляемый грузовик скатился с холма в реку.

definition: a small tower on a castle, or a rotating gun position on a tank
sentence: The castle has a round {turret} at each corner.
translation: У замка по круглой башенке на каждом углу.

definition: to murder an important person, usually for political reasons
sentence: The group planned to {assassinate} the president during the parade.
translation: Группа планировала убить президента во время парада.

definition: a very small living thing that can cause disease
sentence: Wash your hands to stop every {germ} from spreading.
translation: Мой руки, чтобы не разносить микробы.

definition: to finally win or settle something after effort
sentence: A late goal helped the team {clinch} the title.
translation: Поздний гол помог команде завоевать титул.

definition: land covered with grass where farm animals feed
sentence: The cows spend the summer in the high {pasture}.
translation: Коровы проводят лето на высокогорном пастбище.

definition: a smell, often an unpleasant one
sentence: A strange {odor} came from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника шёл странный запах.

definition: to make someone feel that they are no longer welcome or on your side
sentence: The new rules will {alienate} the club's oldest members.
translation: Новые правила оттолкнут самых старых членов клуба.

definition: a small thin piece of something, such as snow or paint
sentence: A {flake} of old paint fell from the ceiling.
translation: С потолка упал кусочек старой краски.

definition: to feel very embarrassed, or to move away from something frightening
sentence: I still {cringe} when I remember what I said at the party.
translation: Я до сих пор сгораю от стыда, вспоминая, что сказал на вечеринке.

definition: to switch a computer off and on again so it starts afresh
sentence: {Reboot} the laptop and try the program again.
translation: Перезагрузи ноутбук и попробуй запустить программу снова.

definition: to gather leaves or smooth soil with a tool that has long teeth
sentence: We {rake} the leaves every Saturday in October.
translation: Каждую субботу в октябре мы сгребаем листья.

definition: the money you receive for your work, or the cheque it is paid with
sentence: Most of my {paycheck} goes on rent and food.
translation: Большая часть моей зарплаты уходит на аренду и еду.

definition: a doctor, or a soldier trained to give first help to the wounded
sentence: A {medic} ran onto the pitch when the player went down.
translation: Врач выбежал на поле, когда игрок упал.

definition: a person who carries or brings something
sentence: Sorry to be the {bearer} of bad news, but the car failed its test.
translation: Не хочу быть вестником плохих новостей, но машина не прошла техосмотр.

definition: a vehicle for passengers that runs on rails along city streets
sentence: The {tram} stops right outside the museum.
translation: Трамвай останавливается прямо у музея.

definition: a problem that delays progress or makes a situation worse
sentence: The injury was a serious {setback} to her plans for the Olympics.
translation: Травма стала серьёзной помехой её планам на Олимпиаду.

definition: a religious group within a larger religion, or the value of a coin or note
sentence: Several Christian {denominations} share the old church.
translation: Несколько христианских конфессий делят старую церковь.

definition: one of the ten rules given by God in the Bible, or any important rule
sentence: The fifth {commandment} tells you to honour your parents.
translation: Пятая заповедь велит почитать родителей.

definition: to make air, water or land dirty and dangerous
sentence: Old factories still {pollute} the river with chemicals.
translation: Старые заводы по-прежнему загрязняют реку химикатами.

definition: a large wild cat with brown fur that lives in America
sentence: A {cougar} was seen near the campsite at dawn.
translation: На рассвете возле кемпинга видели пуму.

definition: able to be changed to suit different needs
sentence: The chair has an {adjustable} back and arms.
translation: У кресла регулируемые спинка и подлокотники.
